mapper.select: SELECT TO_char(evh.BZDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') business_date, TO_char(evh.FINANCIALDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') voucher_date, evh.SYSTEM_ system_code, evh.ORGNUMBER org_id, eva.ASSTACTNUMBER contract_code, eva1.ASSTACTNUMBER client_code, eva2.ASSTACTNUMBER batch_number, EVA3.ASSTACTNUMBER bank_number, eve.ACCOUNTNUMBER account_code, eve.CURRENCYNUMBER currency_code, SUM(eve.DEBITAMOUNT) debit_amount, SUM(eve.CREDITAMOUNT) credit_amount FROM EAS_VOUCHER_HEAD evh LEFT OUTER JOIN EAS_VOUCHER_ENTRY eve ON evh.VOUCHERNUMBER = eve.EAS_VOUCHER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN EAS_VOUCHER_ASSTACT EVA ON eva.EAS_VOUCHER_ID = eve.EAS_VOUCHER_ID AND eva.EAS_VOUCHER_ENTRY_ID = eve.ENTRYSEQ AND eva.ASSTACTTYPENAME = '合同号' LEFT OUTER JOIN EAS_VOUCHER_ASSTACT EVA1 ON eva1.EAS_VOUCHER_ID = eve.EAS_VOUCHER_ID AND eva1.EAS_VOUCHER_ENTRY_ID = eve.ENTRYSEQ AND eva1.ASSTACTTYPENAME = '客户' LEFT OUTER JOIN EAS_VOUCHER_ASSTACT EVA2 ON eva2.EAS_VOUCHER_ID = eve.EAS_VOUCHER_ID AND eva2.EAS_VOUCHER_ENTRY_ID = eve.ENTRYSEQ AND eva2.ASSTACTTYPENAME = '批次号' LEFT OUTER JOIN EAS_VOUCHER_ASSTACT EVA3 ON eva3.EAS_VOUCHER_ID = eve.EAS_VOUCHER_ID AND eva3.EAS_VOUCHER_ENTRY_ID = eve.ENTRYSEQ AND eva3.ASSTACTTYPENAME = '银行账户' WHERE 1 = 1 --eve.EAS_VOUCHER_ID ='zjdb20231225193503800002' AND evh.EASFLAG = 1 AND evh.PERIODMONTH = #{month} AND evh.PERIODYEAR = #{year} -- AND to_char(evh.CREATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '2020-10-23' --to_char(sysdate,'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY TO_char(evh.BZDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), TO_char(evh.FINANCIALDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), evh.SYSTEM_, evh.ORGNUMBER, eva.ASSTACTNUMBER , eva1.ASSTACTNUMBER, eva2.ASSTACTNUMBER, EVA3.ASSTACTNUMBER, eve.ACCOUNTNUMBER, eve.CURRENCYNUMBER
